Enum Class SlotGroupRegion

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<SlotGroupRegion>
com.trevorschoeny.menukit.core.SlotGroupRegion
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<SlotGroupRegion>, Constable
public enum SlotGroupRegion extends Enum<SlotGroupRegion>
Named regions for positioning decoration panels around the bounding box of a slot group. Parallel to MenuRegion — same eight values, same semantics, same flow directions — but anchors to a slot group's bounding rectangle rather than a vanilla menu's container frame.

See Design Docs/Phase 12.5/M8_FOUR_CONTEXT_MODEL.md §5 for context model and §5.5 for why this enum is a separate type from MenuRegion despite having identical members.

Flow direction — stacking grows away from the anchor end, identical to MenuRegion:

  • LEFT_ALIGN_TOP / RIGHT_ALIGN_TOP — flow down
  • LEFT_ALIGN_BOTTOM / RIGHT_ALIGN_BOTTOM — flow up
  • TOP_ALIGN_LEFT / BOTTOM_ALIGN_LEFT — flow right
  • TOP_ALIGN_RIGHT / BOTTOM_ALIGN_RIGHT — flow left
  • TOP_CENTER — flow up (above the group bounds, centered)
  • BOTTOM_CENTER — flow down (below the group bounds, centered)
  • CENTER — no stacking (single-position anchor)

The three centered anchors (TOP_CENTER / BOTTOM_CENTER / CENTER) were added in Phase 3b (Item 4a) for parity with MenuRegion; they resolve against the slot-group bounding rectangle with the same math the menu uses against the container frame.

    • TOP_CENTER

      public static final SlotGroupRegion TOP_CENTER
      Above the slot-group bounding rectangle, centered on the horizontal axis. Stacks UP (away from the group); each sibling stays centered. Parity with MenuRegion.TOP_CENTER.

    • BOTTOM_CENTER

      public static final SlotGroupRegion BOTTOM_CENTER
      Below the slot-group bounding rectangle, centered on the horizontal axis. Stacks DOWN (away from the group); each sibling stays centered. Parity with MenuRegion.BOTTOM_CENTER.

    • CENTER

      public static final SlotGroupRegion CENTER
      Centered within the slot-group bounding rectangle. Single-position anchor — multiple panels in CENTER overlap. Parity with MenuRegion.CENTER.

    • isHorizontalFlow

      public boolean isHorizontalFlow()
      Returns true if panels in this region stack along the X axis — matches MenuRegion.isHorizontalFlow() semantics. The centered anchors flow vertically (TOP_CENTER / BOTTOM_CENTER) or not at all (CENTER), so all three return false.

    • priority

      public RegionAnchor<SlotGroupRegion> priority(int priority)
      Returns a RegionAnchor pairing this region with an explicit stacking priority. Brings SlotGroupRegion to parity with MenuRegion.priority(int) / HudRegion.priority(int) / ScreenRegion.priority(int).

      Pass the result to a SlotGroupPanelAdapter via its RegionAnchor constructor — e.g. new SlotGroupPanelAdapter(panel, SlotGroupRegion.RIGHT_ALIGN_TOP.priority(50)). Lower priority renders first (closer to the region's anchor edge); default is RegionAnchor.DEFAULT_PRIORITY. Sibling panels in the same (category, region) pair stack in (priority, modId, registration) order, identical to the other three region contexts.
